Hover/scale/opacity transitions are omitted (no native hover). Styles are StyleSheet-based and alphabetised; the only inline styles are dynamic (battery fill width/colour, badge/flag colours, freshness colour).

No DOM module, browser HTML element, document/window, react-router-dom, react-i18next, lucide-react, framer-motion, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web @/components import appears in the native output — only react, react-native (Alert/Pressable/ScrollView/StyleSheet/View), @tanstack/react-query, the ported native web-parity api (client/types/useVehicles/usePinned/useSettings), the native parity MetricCard + ConfirmDialog, and the native AppText/GlassPanel + theme tokens. No SI unit-suffixed Go/JSON/TS field is introduced — range stays in SI metres and is converted only at the React display boundary via useUnits()+convertDistanceFromSI.
